title: Walking Tapas and Wine Tour
text: Pitra was a great guide to show us around! Very knowledgeable and a ton of fun. Had a great group of fellow travelers to enjoy the night with. Would highly recommend to anyone looking.

title: Fab food and facts

title: Tapas tour
text: Mario was an exceptional guide.  The tour and tastings at local family owned establishments was excellent!
author: gregoryz624

title: Seville tapas
text: This was a really enjoyable food tour going to lovely family owned traditional tapas restaurants with amazing food. Our guide Alex was so full of local knowledge and positivity and  the tour is one of the best food tours we have been on.
author: Janet_B

title: Amazing Seville tapas tour
text:
Brilliant tour, brilliant guide. Worth every penny. Alex was amazing, answered all of my many questions and you can see how passionate he is about the local area, it's food and drinks and their history.
Fantastic value for money.
author: R7251WPphilr

title: Fabulous food tour in Seville
text: Alex was a fabulous guide. We went to beautiful family restaurants and tapas bars. enjoyed some great wine, great food, great company, well worth the money. definitely recommend
author: wiseguys6

title: A fantastic night of food and fun
text: What an amazing evening we had - not had so much fun in ages. Elena was a superb guide; good-humoured, informative and delightful to be with. She took us to some fabulous authentic bars and we sampled a range of wines and ate a selection of tapas. For my friend and I that was enough for a full meal.  Cannot recommend this tour highly enough.,
author: janerV7568WF

title: Great value for your precious time!
text: Great experience and wonderful guide.  Your time is valuable--you've already spent a lot to travel and stay.  Now you have a few hours and this experience will be a great value.
author: Bradley_F

title: A wonderful way to get to know Seville
text: Mario was a wonderful guide, super knowledgeable and made sure everyone in the group was included. A wonderful way to see more of the city and learn about the food and wine of the area.
author: 262jacquip

title: Well worth it!
text: Mario is fabulous. Our AI tool rated this tour group very high and they are right! Claude was right. Interesting and filling.
